title: Bất động sản — tour căn hộ, nhà phố, villa, homestay, đất
summary: A property tour cut to music: the best view first, then the route a visitor walks (arrival, living, kitchen, bedrooms, bath, the feature), the facts on screen (area, rooms, price, location) and the agent's contact. The footage moves (gimbal walk-throughs), so the virtual camera stays subtle and speed ramps carry the viewer between rooms.
signals: camera walking or gliding through rooms (gimbal, slider, drone)
no one speaking to camera, or one agent presenting

runtime.why: Short enough to finish, long enough to walk every room once.

hook.purpose: the single best shot (view, living room, pool) then the facts
hook.graphics: title with the location or the price; no clutter over the view

structure.purpose: exterior or entrance: where it is, the approach
the main space, light and volume, walk-through
kitchen and dining, one detail shot
the selling point: balcony, view, pool, rooftop, amenities
structure.graphics: title or stat (e.g. 5 phút tới …, estimated)

structure.purpose: a calm wide shot under the facts
structure.graphics: specs card (m², bedrooms, baths, direction, legal status) + price; image for a floor plan

structure.purpose: agent or brand, how to book a viewing
structure.graphics: lowerThird (agent, phone shown only if the user asks), title

music.mood: warm modern, steady 4/4, no vocals over a voiceover; Commercial Music Library / Meta Sound Collection or licensed stock

compliance: Price, area and room count match the listing and the documents; say whether area is thông thủy or tim tường
Legal status (sổ hồng/sổ đỏ, HĐMB) only as the owner's documents state it; never invented
No promised returns, guaranteed price rises or rental yields
Renders, 3D views and virtual staging labelled "hình minh hoạ"; nothing shown that is not part of the sale
Travel times ("5 phút tới…") labelled as estimates
Broker or developer identified; phone numbers only if the user asks to show them
Faces of residents, neighbours and house numbers of other homes kept out of frame or blurred
Music licensed for commercial use (business account)

voiceover.about: An agent's voiceover (or on-camera intro) carries the tour; cuts follow the voice.
